_help.minSeats: Fewest seats (players + bots) a game can start with.
_help.idleWarnAfterMs: A player whose move the game is waiting for, who does nothing (no tap, no key, no move) this long in ms, sees a draining bar: a bot takes over soon. 0 = no warning.
_help.idleTakeoverAfterMs: …and after this long (ms) a bot plays their seat, mid-turn, until they tap anything. 0 = never.
_help.botTakesOverAfterMs: A player who drops out mid-game gets a bot after this long, in ms (0 = never). They can still come back.
_help.keepEmptyRoomMs: Everyone gone mid-game: how long (ms) the room waits for someone to come back before it's cleared.
_help.allowBots: May the host add bot seats in the lobby? (The game's rules must then play for bots.)
_help.maxMessagesPerSecond: Messages one player's connection may send per second; more are dropped unread (flooding). 0 = no limit.
